episodes.title: Hear 4: That one time I was in a Cult...
episodes.description: Send us Fan Mail Everyone has a story to tell, and it's finally time for me to share one of mine. In this deeply personal episode of Hear 4 You, I open up about my experience being involved in a cult-like group operating under the umbrella of Santería, an Afro-Cuban religion with a rich history, beautiful traditions, and a meaningful place in the lives of its practitioners. I want to make something very clear from the beginning: Santería itself was not the problem. The problem was the people who used it as a tool for manipulation, control, and financial exploitation. What started in 2021 as a search for spiritual guidance, community, and purpose eventually became a years-long experience that took us down a road we never expected. From religious ceremonies and initiations to questionable practices, emotional manipulation, escalating financial demands, and leaders who seemed to place themselves above the very people they were supposed to guide, I'll walk you through what happened and how we eventually found our way out. I'll share some of the experiences that opened my eyes, including: How my wife and I initially became involved in the group. The spiritual promises and personal connections that drew us in. My experiences with Mano de Orula, being crowned Ochosi, and traveling to Cuba for religious ceremonies. The warning signs I noticed along the way, and why it took so long to recognize what was happening. How manipulation and emotional attachment can make it difficult to walk away. The moment things finally came to a head and why we decided enough was enough. But this isn't simply a story about the bad experiences. There were beautiful moments, incredible people, meaningful connections, and cultural experiences that I wouldn't trade for anything. I had the opportunity to experience Cuban culture, meet wonderful people, and see firsthand what this religion means to those who genuinely practice it. Unfortunately, I also saw how easily something beautiful can be twisted when the wrong people are given power over others. My hope is that sharing this story helps someone recognize the warning signs of manipulation, understand the difference between faith and control, and remember that no spiritual leader should ever have the right to dictate your worth, your relationships, or your life. And perhaps most importantly, I hope this opens the door for others who experienced something similar to share their stories. You deserve community without control, guidance without manipulation, and faith without fear. Thank you for being here, and as always, thank you for listening to Hear 4 You. 📩 Have a story to share or questions about this episode? Reach out at hear4youpod@gmail.com .
